{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id entries and keep the highest sample_seq for each patient
data_sorted = data.sort_values(by='sample_seq', ascending=False)
data_unique = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now check the severity column
data_unique['severity'].value_counts()"}
